verdicts.reason: A keeps one clean left edge (quote mark, quote, attribution and logo all at about x=205), but the whole layout is a shrunk, centred copy with wide dead margins. The purple circle floats in mid-canvas instead of bleeding off the corner as in the original, it almost touches the quote's last line, and the attribution and logo are now tiny. B keeps the circle bleeding off the edge, but its left edges are broken: the quote mark (x≈85), quote (x≈205), attribution (x≈145) and logo (x≈92) all start at different positions. The attribution sits outdented from the quote it belongs to, and the attribution text and the SOLSTICE label are tiny and hard to read.
